family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF3050, represents HamA, the key enzyme responsible for forming the nitrogen-nitrogen bond in the diazeniumdiolate moiety of fungicide fragin [[cite:PUB00163876]]. HamA adopts a heme oxygenase-like fold, forming a hydrophobic cavity within a helical bundle that likely accommodates the substrate [[cite:PUB00163876]].
family.name: HamA Heme-Oxygenase-like enzyme family
